# Test cases for urljoin_ based on RFC 3986 reference resolution

# 1. Empty string returning base without its fragment
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path?q=1#frag", "") == "http://base.com/path?q=1", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path?q=1#frag", ""), "http://base.com/path?q=1")

# 2. Absolute URLs replace the base
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "https://other.com/new") == "https://other.com/new", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "https://other.com/new"), "https://other.com/new")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "ftp://files.com/data") == "ftp://files.com/data", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "ftp://files.com/data"), "ftp://files.com/data")

# 3. Scheme-relative URLs (//host/p)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "//other.com/new") == "http://other.com/new", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "//other.com/new"), "http://other.com/new")
assert urljoin_("https://base.com/path/", "//sub.domain.com") == "https://sub.domain.com", (urljoin_("https://base.com/path/", "//sub.domain.com"), "https://sub.domain.com")

# 4. Absolute paths (/p)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "/absolute/path") == "http://base.com/absolute/path", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "/absolute/path"), "http://base.com/absolute/path")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "/root") == "http://base.com/root", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "/root"), "http://base.com/root")

# 5. Relative paths
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "sub/page") == "http://base.com/path/sub/page", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "sub/page"), "http://base.com/path/sub/page")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "sub/page") == "http://base.com/sub/page", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path", "sub/page"), "http://base.com/sub/page")

# 6. Dot (.) and Double Dot (..) normalization
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/dir/", "../other") == "http://base.com/path/other", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/dir/", "../other"), "http://base.com/path/other")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/dir/", "../../root") == "http://base.com/root", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/dir/", "../../root"), "http://base.com/root")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "./page") == "http://base.com/path/page", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "./page"), "http://base.com/path/page")
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "../..") == "http://base.com/", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "../.."), "http://base.com/")

# 7. Query-only references (?q)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "?query=1") == "http://base.com/path/?query=1", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "?query=1"), "http://base.com/path/?query=1")

# 8. Fragment-only references (#f)
assert urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "#section1") == "http://base.com/path/#section1", (urljoin_("http://base.com/path/", "#section1"), "http://base.com/path/#section1")

# 9. Complex combination
assert urljoin_("http://example.com/a/b/", "../c?d=e#f") == "http://example.com/a/c?d=e#f", (urljoin_("http://example.com/a/b/", "../c?d=e#f"), "http://example.com/a/c?d=e#f")

def urljoin_(base, url):
    def parse_url(u):
        scheme = ""
        netloc = ""
        path = ""
        query = ""
        fragment = ""
        
        if not u:
            return scheme, netloc, path, query, fragment
            
        # Extract fragment
        if "#" in u:
            u, fragment = u.split("#", 1)
            fragment = "#" + fragment
            
        # Extract query
        if "?" in u:
            u, query = u.split("?", 1)
            query = "?" + query
            
        # Extract scheme
        if "://" in u:
            scheme, u = u.split("://", 1)
            scheme += "://"
        elif ":" in u and "/" not in u.split(":")[0]:
            parts = u.split(":", 1)
            scheme = parts[0] + ":"
            u = parts[1]
            
        # Extract netloc and path
        if u.startswith("//"):
            u = u[2:]
            parts = u.split("/", 1)
            netloc = parts[0]
            path = "/" + parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "/"
        elif u.startswith("/"):
            path = u
        else:
            # If there is no scheme and no //, but there is a : (like mailto:), 
            # it was handled above. If it's just a path like 'path/to', netloc is empty.
            parts = u.split("/", 1)
            netloc = ""
            path = parts[0]
            if len(parts) > 1:
                path += "/" + parts[1]
                
        return scheme, netloc, path, query, fragment

    # Parse base and target
    b_scheme, b_netloc, b_path, b_query, b_frag = parse_url(base)
    t_scheme, t_netloc, t_path, t_query, t_frag = parse_url(url)

    # 1. Empty string returning base without its fragment
    if url == "":
        return b_scheme + b_netloc + b_path + b_query

    # 2. Absolute URL (has scheme or starts with //)
    if t_scheme or t_netloc:
        return t_scheme + t_netloc + t_path + t_query + t_frag

    # 3. Scheme-relative (starts with //)
    if url.startswith("//"):
        return b_scheme + "//" + t_netloc + t_path + t_query + t_frag

    # 4. Absolute path (starts with /)
    if t_path.startswith("/"):
        return b_scheme + b_netloc + t_path + t_query + t_frag

    # 5. Query-only or Fragment-only references
    if t_path == "" and t_query:
        return b_scheme + b_netloc + b_path + t_query + t_frag
    if t_path == "" and t_frag:
        return b_scheme + b_netloc + b_path + b_query + t_frag

    # 6. Relative path, . , ..
    # Determine base directory
    if not b_path or b_path == "/":
        base_dir = "/"
    else:
        last_slash = b_path.rfind("/")
        if last_slash == -1:
            base_dir = "/"
        else:
            base_dir = b_path[:last_slash + 1]

    # Normalize path segments
    segments = [s for s in base_dir.split("/") if s]
    new_segments = []
    
    # Add base segments
    for s in segments:
        new_segments.append(s)
        
    # Process target path
    target_parts = t_path.split("/")
    for part in target_parts:
        if part == "..":
            if new_segments:
                new_segments.pop()
        elif part == "." or part == "":
            continue
        else:
            new_segments.append(part)

    # Reconstruct path
    res_path = "/" + "/".join(new_segments)
    if not res_path: res_path = "/"
    
    return b_scheme + b_netloc + res_path + t_query + t_frag
